types.name: RRenderer

fields.name: unk18

fields.name: screenCapturePending

fields.name: screenHeight

fields.name: resMode

fields.name: scaleX

fields.name: scaleY

fields.name: renderContext

fields.name: viewPort

fields.name: debugFont

fields.name: frameEnded

types.comment: Singleton, no vptr. RRenderer::Init 7d5e0 FastAllocs 0x90 and constructs (7d2a0), stored in global 0x1ebff4 (the ctor also writes this there). PS2 layout differs past +0x10 (PS2 has 64-bit stores at +0x18/+0x20 and 4-byte bools), so Xbox offsets come from Xbox code only.

types.name: RRenderHigh

fields.name: playerViews
fields.comment: medium: 4 entries of {RViewCamera* view, RPlayerCamera* player}: ctor MEM_fill(this,0,0x20); after PushPlayerView the ctor reads [this+count*8-8] as a camera; PS2 Render reads +0x0 -> RViewCamera::Render, +0x4 addr-taken in PopPlayerView/ReceiveCamer

fields.name: playerViewCount
fields.comment: high: index for the 8-byte entries (ctor, PushPlayerView, PopPlayerView, RearrangeSplitScreens, ReceiveCameraInput); same offset on PS2. Name invented

fields.name: unk24
fields.comment: low: ctor zeroes, dtor reads. Name invented

fields.name: hudView
fields.comment: high: ctor FastAlloc 0x4c tag 'RRenderHUDView', 96ae0 (RViewCamera ctor) then vtable 0x191aa8. Name from the tag

fields.name: debugViewPerspective
fields.comment: high: ctor FastAlloc 0x50 tag 'RRenderDebugViewPerspective', ctor 8b300(camera), [obj+0x10]=7; PS2 Render -> RViewCamera::Render. Name from the tag

fields.name: debugViewScreenSpace
fields.comment: high: ctor FastAlloc 0x4c tag 'RRenderDebugViewScreenSpace', ctor 8b3a0, [obj+0x10]=7. Name from the tag

fields.name: unk38

fields.name: unk3c
fields.comment: low: ctor zeroes (PS2 +0x40 is a 64-bit value passed to __floatdisf). Name invented

fields.name: targetFps
fields.comment: low: ctor = 60.0f (0x42700000); PS2 +0x48 float in Render. Name invented

types.comment: No vptr: the vtable 0x191aa8 its ctor stores goes into a newly allocated RRenderHUDView (tag string at 0x191a58), not into this. Constructed as a local in RunTheGame (ESP+0x11c at 5aab6) and published via global 0x1ec488 (fgThis). Size is only a lower bound (last field +0x40).

types.name: WRender

fields.name: map
fields.comment: high: ctor c7a50: data pointer of the 'Map ' chunk (UGroup locate 117950/117a60); DrawWorld/DrawWorldAtPoint read. CARP::Map. Name invented

fields.name: bucketInstances
fields.comment: medium: ctor zeroes +0x4..+0x14 then sorts 64-byte CARP instances into 5 buckets (by shader byte +0x1d or flag 4): [this+4+b*4]=instance; empty buckets get filled from the next. PS2 +0x4 addr-taken in CopyDrawPasses/DrawPass. Name invented

fields.name: bucketCounts
fields.comment: medium: ctor zeroes +0x18..+0x28 and increments [this+0x18+b*4] per instance; +0x28 re-zeroed; PS2 +0x18 addr-taken. Name invented

fields.name: psChunk
fields.comment: medium: ctor: data of the 'ps  ' chunk or 0; PS2 DrawPass/DrawWorldAtPoint read +0x2c. Name invented

fields.name: curtainCount
fields.comment: high: ctor: element count of the 'VisC' chunk; loop bound. Name invented

fields.name: curtains
fields.comment: high: ctor: FastAlloc(count*0x20), zeroed, filled by d0ff0 per 'VisC' entry; FindVisibleTreeNodesAndCurtains reads. Name invented

fields.name: unkd4
fields.comment: low: FindVisibleTreeNodesAndCurtains R/W, GenerateCurtainsAndNodes; same on PS2. Name invented

fields.name: unkd8
fields.comment: low: GenerateCurtainsAndNodes(RCamera&, float) writes; PS2 swc1 (float). Name invented

types.comment: No vptr; size 224 from the constructed-size table. Same offsets on PS2 for every field seen. +0x38..+0xd3 not seen in its own methods.

types.name: RTextureContext

fields.name: vtable

fields.name: flags
fields.comment: low: ctor writes (probably the unsigned int ctor arg); PS2 ctor +0x4. Name invented

fields.name: fileData
fields.comment: medium: loaded file buffer: ctor (UFileLoader::FileLoadz), Unload/Find* read; PS2 Load writes, Unload -> UMemory::Free. Name invented

fields.name: textureMap
fields.comment: medium: heap MSVC tree (12-byte block, node alloc 93310); 932b0/93350/93d90 walk it in Find/FindOrCreateTexture/Unload; freed by the deleting dtor. Name invented

types.comment: Deleting destructor 93e80 frees 0x10 (this) and 0xc (the map head block at +0xc). Same offsets on PS2 (vptr at +0 there too).

fields.name: vtable

fields.name: contexts

types.comment: Singleton: RTextureContextManager::Init 8b700 operator new(8) + ctor 95080, global 0x1f2a30. 95080 is the constructor (named RTextureContext_or_ContextManager).

fields.name: particleCache
